newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Generali launches convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Generali launches convertible bond.

text.p: Italian insurer Assicurazioni Generali said it was launching a five year bond in eurolire and convertible into shares of insurer Alleanza, for a total of about 800 billion lire.
Generali, which controls Alleanza, said in a statement the terms of the bond would be announced in the next few days.
The bond which would be quoted on the Luxembourg market would be placed with institutional investors in Italy and abroad by investment houses Mediobanca, Goldman Sachs and Paribas.
The operation aimed to free resources which could be used for further growth in the insurance sector and improve total current profitability, Generali said.
